response.sql: WITH per_order_averages AS (SELECT COALESCE(ordersmark, 'NULL_ORDER') as ordersmark_key, AVG(fillcount) as avg_fillcount FROM orderexecutions WHERE fillcount IS NOT NULL AND fillcount > 0 GROUP BY COALESCE(ordersmark, 'NULL_ORDER')), first_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fillcount) as benchmark1 FROM per_order_averages), filtered_first AS (SELECT poa.ordersmark_key, poa.avg_fillcount, poa.avg_fillcount - fb.benchmark1 as excess1 FROM per_order_averages poa CROSS JOIN first_benchmark fb WHERE poa.avg_fillcount > fb.benchmark1), second_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fillcount) as benchmark2 FROM filtered_first), filtered_second AS (SELECT ff.ordersmark_key, ff.avg_fillcount, ff.excess1, ff.avg_fillcount - sb.benchmark2 as excess2 FROM filtered_first ff CROSS JOIN second_benchmark sb WHERE ff.avg_fillcount > sb.benchmark2) SELECT AVG(avg_fillcount) as avg_per_order_fill, AVG(excess1) as avg_first_excess, AVG(excess2) as avg_second_excess FROM filtered_second
